scope: Capability review of the 885 HIGH_REFERENCE_EXTENSION source pages from OM20; no new runtime contract, priority downgrade or broader compatibility acceptance. Source presence/nearby features are not proof of the full Excel member.

status_meanings.ELIGIBLE_NATIVE: Existing native behavior supports a bounded projection candidate; implementation, exact binding/lifetime/error tests and any write path are still required.
status_meanings.NATIVE_SUBSET: Related native state/effects exist, but a named semantic, editable field, receiver or service boundary is incomplete. Not automatically eligible as a whole member.
status_meanings.NO_NATIVE_CAPABILITY: The named source behavior has no matching native product capability in the inspected state/dispatch; do not add it for VBA parity.
status_meanings.HOST_SERVICE_REVIEW: Host/UI dependency needs a concrete existing service and headless/browser behavior review before projection.
status_meanings.GENERIC_DISPATCH: Existing generic formula-dispatch route is present, but these source members are absent from the explicit metadata list. Verify each registration/signature and runtime binding before promoting catalogue state.

groups.native_backing: These two registered functions deliberately return #VALUE!; registration is not an implemented XML/network service.
groups.boundary: Do not promote descriptor presence to success. Network/XML implementation belongs on the product roadmap.

groups.native_backing: The existing WorksheetFunction dispatcher normalizes underscores to dots and calls the calculator; these source pages lack entries in FUNCTION_MEMBERS.
groups.boundary: Candidate metadata/test repair only. Confirm each calculator registration and argument signature, then add native/WASM binding regressions before claiming a supported member; no full option parity is inferred.

groups.native_backing: view.formulaBar already reads/writes Session.prefs.formula_bar without requiring a workbook.
groups.boundary: Project the same preference; preserve headless operation and do not create a second VBA setting.

groups.native_backing: The print/page-setup boundary already uses points at 72 points per inch. Pure scalar unit conversion needs no new product service.
groups.boundary: Validate finite numeric inputs and VBA coercion/overflow. Reuse the existing point/inch convention.

groups.native_backing: Workbook.custom_lists is consumed by native fill.
groups.boundary: Storage is workbook-scoped, unlike Excel application-wide custom lists. Define scope, built-in list numbering and mutation ownership before selecting a projection.

groups.native_backing: The calculator, reference formatter and worksheet UDF provider exist.
groups.boundary: No automatic equivalence for busy-state enums, save policies, build versions, caller context or volatility registration. Select exact existing read contexts; do not add compatibility-only global flags.

groups.native_backing: Session owns undo/redo and native commands.
groups.boundary: Excel custom undo/repeat procedure registration and macro-group interaction are not provided by ordinary engine history. Only bounded native-history behavior is a candidate.

groups.native_backing: Native charts, documents, windows and close continuations exist.
groups.boundary: Chart sheets, Application aliases, application-wide visibility/quit and unsaved-document orchestration need exact receiver/host contracts. Existing worksheet chart ownership is not an Excel Charts collection.

groups.native_backing: The desktop UI owns rendering, formula completion, window geometry and user preferences; these are not all Session host services.
groups.boundary: Inspect the specific UI capability and add an owned host-neutral query/continuation only when it already exists. Geometry, recent-file state and UI-only preferences must not be fabricated headlessly.

groups.native_backing: GridCraft has a basic spelling query and bounded example-based Flash Fill.
groups.boundary: Excel dictionary options, AutoCorrect graph and automatic Flash Fill modes are broader than those commands; only matched subsets may be projected.

groups.native_backing: The host has preferences, localized display and default workbook/style state.
groups.boundary: Read actual GridCraft defaults where available. Excel process-wide locale, navigation and new-workbook setters are not established by having a display formatter or per-workbook Normal style.

groups.native_backing: The IDE can pause and await owned host operations; UI input and scheduling are host-owned.
groups.boundary: Existing continuations do not supply an Excel timer scheduler, blocking Wait, SendKeys automation or global input lock. Review service availability before selecting any contract.

groups.native_backing: Inspected native Application dispatch, Session preferences and workbook state provide no matching Office process/settings/provider object for these remaining source contracts.
groups.boundary: No Office installation paths/build identity, COM/DDE/cluster/add-in graph, SmartArt/Speech, recovery scheduler, search-format object or miscellaneous Excel-only option is synthesized. This group is an exclusion of the named source contracts, not of similar GridCraft UI features.

groups.native_backing: DocState.content_kind and native FileKind/path detection retain actual file format provenance.
groups.boundary: Map only known formats and define unsaved-document behavior; do not claim that every readable format is writable.

groups.native_backing: Workbook date system, calculation settings, show_objects, theme, sheet charts/pivots and the native forecast command exist.
groups.boundary: Some fields are retained metadata, not editable services; table-style selection is not an arbitrary TableStyles editor. Verify exact command behavior, chart-sheet exclusion, aggregate ownership and persisted settings before adding members.

groups.native_backing: Native file paths, document properties, annotations, trust/protection and open/save exist.
groups.boundary: A protected or untrusted workbook is not an Excel read-only/write-reservation flag. No import/export fidelity, property stripping, write reservation or custom-property writer is inferred from those nearby services.

groups.native_backing: The native Workbook/DocState do not contain the named Office sharing, DDE, workflow, data-model/XML provider, compatibility-mode or application option graphs.
groups.boundary: Opaque package preservation and local pivots do not establish those services. Keep the named source contracts outside the native delivery queue.

groups.native_backing: Workbook.sheets has ordered identities; Sheet stores its default row height in 96-DPI pixels and represents an ordinary worksheet.
groups.boundary: No activation during neighbour reads; boundary returns Nothing. Convert height to points and report only supported worksheet kinds.

groups.native_backing: Sheet.tab_color is rendered by the sheet tabs and edited through sheet.tabColor.
groups.boundary: A new Tab handle must capture sheet identity, reject stale/deleted/recreated sheets and share native protection/undo. Palette ColorIndex remains outside this candidate.

groups.native_backing: Native calculation, widths, error queries, page-break preview, spelling, save, pivots and protection permissions exist.
groups.boundary: Calculate Sheet currently uses the same calc_now implementation as full calculation; range/sheet-selective semantics are not proven. Error queries do not supply persistent tracer/circle overlays, and UI-only-protection flags need the existing permission model.

groups.native_backing: data.consolidate computes native output.
groups.boundary: The command does not retain an Excel current-consolidation source/options record. Existing consolidation effects alone do not make these historical queries implementable.

groups.native_backing: Sheet stores no per-sheet calculation/CF-enable toggles, Office custom properties, legacy Lotus parsing mode, background picture or XML mapping/query service.
groups.boundary: Local conditional formatting and static images do not establish those exact source contracts.

groups.native_backing: Sheet.show_formulas is persisted native state and formulas.showFormulas already changes it.
groups.boundary: Use actual sheet-backed window views; independent Excel window state is unavailable. Preserve existing OM08 context/lifetime rules.

groups.native_backing: Native sheet add/copy/move/delete/select/visibility and page-break services already exist.
groups.boundary: Collection fan-out needs index-list/default, atomicity, last-visible-sheet, protection, cross-workbook and grouped-selection contracts. Add2 is not a second sheet-kind implementation.

groups.native_backing: Native file open does not provide checkout, database import or XML-map import services.
groups.boundary: Existing CSV/XLSX readers do not establish these source contracts.

groups.native_backing: Existing close and file host continuations support native documents and ordinary import/export.
groups.boundary: All-workbook Close must preserve per-document consent/cancel/undo behavior. OpenText requires actual text-import options; database/XML checkout services are not supplied by file open.

groups.native_backing: Native tab colors use the shared RGB/theme/tint Color representation and sheet.tabColor.
groups.boundary: Add an identity-bearing receiver first; preserve native validation, reset/no-color behavior and existing command protection/undo. No palette-index API is implied.

groups.native_backing: GridCraft tab colors support RGB/theme/tint/automatic, not an editable legacy indexed color palette.
groups.boundary: Do not invent Excel palette mappings.

groups.native_backing: Native Color::Theme stores theme slot and tint; border style patches use native commands.
groups.boundary: Extend existing border handles and mixed-value semantics without introducing a palette.

groups.native_backing: RGB/theme colors and border collections exist.
groups.boundary: ColorIndex and Borders.Value require legacy palette/default-enumeration semantics not established by Color::Theme; retain as contract-limited candidates.

groups.native_backing: Native named styles carry full Style values and existing adapter handles support cell font/fill/alignment patches.
groups.boundary: New style-child handles must edit the named style, not selected cells; built-in immutability, name identity, localization and stale children need contract tests.

groups.native_backing: Workbook.cell_styles supports native named styles.
groups.boundary: Include* flags, AddIndent/ReadingOrder and cross-workbook merge/delete remapping are not all fields of Style. Do not claim whole Style/Styles behavior from the existing catalog.

groups.native_backing: Native Font has bold/italic flags and theme body-font linkage.
groups.boundary: Composite FontStyle names and full major/minor/none ThemeFont setters need exact mapping and existing-format command support; arbitrary names are not inferred.

groups.native_backing: Native Font has no Excel chart/font background mode.
groups.boundary: Do not substitute fill color for Font.Background.

groups.native_backing: The native find/replace engine has no persistent Application.FindFormat/ReplaceFormat CellFormat criteria object.
groups.boundary: Normal cell formatting support is not a search-format state service.

groups.native_backing: The renderer/calculator compute native conditional formats and display strings.
groups.boundary: Read-only effective style is related native backing; mixed-cell values, conditional-style precedence, UDF restrictions and child handle lifetimes need a bounded contract. It must not become a writable style proxy.

groups.native_backing: Native CF rules hold boxed differential styles and text/time-period rules.
groups.boundary: Select only existing rule kinds; new style children must write the owning rule and preserve identity/undo. Do not map unrelated rule kinds to Text/DateOperator.

groups.native_backing: Native CondKind supports specific cell-based color scales, icons, data bars and top/average/unique rules.
groups.boundary: PTCondition/ScopeType/CalcFor pivot scope, arbitrary Formula, data-bar axis/border/negative colors and icon percentiles are not all stored. Select individual native fields; do not create settings to mimic Excel.

groups.native_backing: Native CF stores data-bar colors and icon-set names/thresholds and renders them.
groups.boundary: Separate border/negative-bar objects, custom icon assignment and icon-object identity are absent. Existing colors/icons only justify a subset review, not a complete nominal graph.

groups.native_backing: Native fill styles preserve solid/patterned color and known file style information.
groups.boundary: The cell Fill API is not an editable gradient-stop collection or chart inversion service. Verify retained versus editable fields before projecting any gradient or pattern-theme option.

groups.native_backing: Native cell/text storage and existing Characters handles expose bounded text operations.
groups.boundary: Insertion and phonetic characters need exact run/UTF-16 indexing and rich-text preservation; whole-text replacement is not proof of per-run mutation.

groups.native_backing: Workbook.phonetics retains PhoneticString/PhoneticRun/PhoneticProps for XLSX round trips.
groups.boundary: This is shared-string preservation, not a per-cell editable phonetic graph, Japanese reading generator or visibility/font command service. Read subsets need aliasing and identity review; do not infer setters.

groups.native_backing: Native Table fields, columns, selection and autofilter are already projected.
groups.boundary: Some descriptive/dropdown settings are not retained. Inspect individual stored fields; reserve ownership and never infer a new insert row or accessibility option from a nearby Range.

groups.native_backing: Local tables have no SharePoint ListDataFormat, XPath/XML/provider refresh, TableObject result-import lifecycle or publish service.
groups.boundary: A local ListObject/table slicer is not those external provider contracts. Ordinary table operations remain supported independently.

groups.native_backing: Native tables retain style selection and render built-in style patterns.
groups.boundary: No arbitrary editable TableStyleElements catalog, duplicated custom table-style graph or Office style availability flags follow from built-in style rendering. Stored style selection may support a smaller read-only subset.

groups.native_backing: Native create-from-selection, paste-name list, Go To Special comparisons and defined names exist.
groups.boundary: Exact range anchoring, names/default aliases, sparse area results, omitted compare cell, protection and no-partial-write validation must be specified before delivery.

groups.native_backing: cell.get exposes formatted display text; native indent commands update alignment.
groups.boundary: Text needs Excel multi-cell mixed/Null rules and a declared width/rendering boundary. InsertIndent must use the existing command limits and protection, with captured-sheet context.

groups.native_backing: Sheet rows/columns/default sizes provide geometry and existing sizing commands.
groups.boundary: Pixel/point and Excel column-character units, hidden lines, multi-area anchors and default-reset behavior need explicit contracts; no desktop screen geometry is implied.

groups.native_backing: Native calc dirty tracking and precedent/dependent queries exist.
groups.boundary: Current Calculate Sheet uses workbook calc; ordered selective range recalculation and persistent navigation/arrow overlays are not provided merely by trace queries. Same-sheet reference subsets need proof.

groups.native_backing: Native outline/subtotal/sort/text tools, table membership, formulas and range editing exist.
groups.boundary: Exact historical flags, Lotus-specific sort/parse, subtotal removal identity, automatic outline inference, prefix/array provenance and macro receiver semantics are not established by nearby commands. Pick matched subsets only.

groups.native_backing: Native home.borders accepts edge presets, style and RGB/theme color; existing border handles use those commands.
groups.boundary: Respect mutually exclusive Excel options, multi-area budgets, captured receiver, protection and one undo group; no ColorIndex palette is added.

groups.native_backing: Text handles, effective rendering, error queries and phonetic preservation exist independently.
groups.boundary: No automatic reading generator, per-cell ignored-error graph or editable phonetic runs follows. Refer to the corresponding child-family reviews before creating a receiver.

groups.native_backing: edit.flashFill/data.flashFill already perform bounded example-based transformation.
groups.boundary: Project only that existing algorithm and command limits; do not claim Excel inference parity or invent automatic-mode settings.

groups.native_backing: Sheet.sparklines holds existing rendered and persisted sparklines.
groups.boundary: There is no explicit group identity/configuration record. A native-compatible collection subset needs a stable grouping/lifetime contract, not grouping by guessed adjacency.

groups.native_backing: Native Sparkline stores cell/source/kind/color/markers and insert.sparkline creates entries; renderer and PDF reuse them.
groups.boundary: Basic reads/type/source/color/delete may be candidates, but group identity, axes, points, date ranges, grouping, weights and blank-data policy are not all stored. Review member-by-member before a bounded graph is selected.

groups.native_backing: Native formula/error values and errorChecking query exist.
groups.boundary: A cell value error is not Excel background error-checking categories or persistent Ignore flags. No complete Error/Errors object is currently justified.

groups.native_backing: Native AutoFilter/FilterCriterion/Sort state and existing VBA sort/filter graphs exist.
groups.boundary: Range/read-only Rng, key priority and criteria count can use existing state only after exact index/order contracts; custom icon/value sort services and ModifyKey must honor current supported sort kinds.

groups.native_backing: Native outline has levels/visibility/summary placement but no automatic outline-style application preference.
groups.boundary: Do not map AutomaticStyles to show_outline_symbols or summary direction.

groups.native_backing: Native scenario storage and selected Scenario projection exist.
groups.boundary: Scenario.Locked protection metadata and cross-workbook merge/deduplication are not equivalent to applying an existing scenario; inspect storage before adding flags or merge behavior.

groups.native_backing: Native DefinedName carries identity, name, scope, formula, comment and hidden state.
groups.boundary: Index can be derived with a documented ordering; category/macro shortcuts and workbook parameter flags are not stored. No compatibility-only metadata is added.

groups.native_backing: Native chart/series/title settings and formula evaluation exist.
groups.boundary: Series source formulas and literal title text do not establish worksheet-linked title/DataLabel formulas or arbitrary Chart.Evaluate context; locale/R1C1 translation and handle ownership need separate review.

groups.native_backing: Local pivots and the formula engine do not supply OLAP calculated-member, data-model measure or Get & Transform query objects.
groups.boundary: A formula string is not a provider/model execution service.

groups.native_backing: Local pivot calculated fields have formula/source records and native calculation.
groups.boundary: OLAP calculated members/items, model measures, queries, PivotFormulas export/listing and standard-language conversion are broader graphs and are not inferred from calculated fields. Provider/model contracts stay excluded; inspect local formula subsets first.

groups.native_backing: Native format import/export is a fixed FileKind service; workbook recovery scheduling and plugin converter catalogs are not those services.
groups.boundary: Do not generate fake converter entries or recovery settings from ordinary file save.

groups.native_backing: Recent-document presentation belongs to the desktop host, outside the workbook graph.
groups.boundary: Verify actual recent-list persistence/ownership, filesystem consent, browser availability and callback cancellation before selecting a host service. No per-bridge synthetic list.

groups.native_backing: Native ShapeFormat and object collections do not provide the named Office forms-control, WordArt, linked OLE or used-object memory-accounting graphs.
groups.boundary: Cell checkboxes, plain text shapes and static images retain their existing projections independently.

groups.native_backing: Native validation stores rules/messages but has no input-method mode state or host IME-control service.
groups.boundary: Do not substitute list validation or text entry for IMEMode.

groups.native_backing: Session.prefs.user_name actually supplies authors for new workbooks, notes and comment replies.
groups.boundary: Project the real preference for subsequent operations; do not rewrite existing authors or emulate an Office account identity.

groups.native_backing: Session.new_workbook uses prefs.sheets_in_new_workbook with native 1..255 bounds.
groups.boundary: Preserve native limits and affect newly created workbooks only; do not mutate existing sheet collections.

groups.native_backing: UiState.animations is a persisted preference used by native selection rendering.
groups.boundary: Requires an owned UI preference seam and headless/browser policy; it is not an Excel macro-animation scheduler.

groups.native_backing: The UI implements real AutoSave for dirty saved .xlsx workbooks, controlled by UiState.autosave.
groups.boundary: Native preference is host-wide rather than per-workbook/cloud AutoSave. Review ownership and file consent before exposing a bounded contract; do not confuse it with AutoRecover.

evidence_boundary.method: Pinned public source extraction plus direct native/model/adapter source inspection. Evidence anchors are checked against the current checkout; exclusions are snapshot review judgments, not an automated proof of absence.
evidence_boundary.counts: Source pages, not engineering estimates or Excel compatibility percentages.

maintenance: When an extension is delivered, update this remaining-review ledger with the owning runtime acceptance ledger and regenerate/check the audit together. Retain the immutable source inventory and source-path provenance.

offline_audit.command: cargo run -p xtask --features vba-audit -- vba-audit --write; cargo run -p xtask --features vba-audit -- vba-audit
